title: Gmail to Vector Embeddings with PGVector and Ollama
description:
## Magic here 🪄
#### (not really, just statistics)
E-mail is stored in a `emails_metadata` structured table, and also fed to the [`nomic-embed-text`]({{ $env.WEBHOOK_URL }} model to be stored in a `emails_embeddings` table as [vector embeddings]({{ $env.WEBHOOK_URL }} so similarity searches are possible.

The `email_id` field can be used to make the relation between the structured records and the vector embeddings, as it's stored in their metadata as `emails_metadata.id`.
This is also the case for `thread_id`.
